err.http_login:
LuCI/ubus login failed (status={status}): {base}
Check username/password, or whether the account is allowed in the web UI
err.http_no_session:
The router ubus has no session object; rpcd is not running, so login is impossible.
This is not a username/password error. On the router run:
  /etc/init.d/rpcd restart
  /etc/init.d/uhttpd restart
Or start rpcd in LuCI System → Startup.
err.router_disconnected: Cannot reach the router: connection dropped
err.session_expired: ubus session expired; automatic restore failed
err.ssh_refused:
Connection refused: {host}:{port}
  Cause: SSH is not listening on that port
Fix: 1) confirm the OpenWrt SSH port (default 22)
        2) check /etc/config/dropbear
        3) retry with -p for the real SSH port
err.ssh_no_route:
No route to {host}
  Cause: host unreachable
Check: 1) router IP (it may have changed)
        2) local network/DNS
        3) DHCP leases for the current IP
err.ssh_net_unreach:
Network unreachable: no default route or not on the same subnet
Check: this machine is connected to the same router
err.ssh_net:
Network error ({host}:{port}): {error}
If the router just rebooted, wait 1–2 minutes and retry
err.ssh_proto:
SSH protocol error: {error}
The server SSH version may be incompatible, or the connection limit is reached
err.ssh_exec_drop: Connection dropped while running the command: {error}
err.ssh_not_json:
Command output is not valid JSON:
{output}
